# Results (regenerated by offline script)

Produced by `bash scripts/run_blue_orchestrator_offline.sh`.

| File | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `config_space.json` | Full config × attack enumeration with validity flags |
| `sweep.json` | Full fixed sweep on the simulator |
| `learning_curve.json` | Orchestrator vs random top-2 factor recovery vs sweep |
| `migration_order.json` | Ranked upgrade steps from sweep labels |
| `r1_eval.json` | Blue Agent vs provisional grader (fixtures, heuristic mode) |
| `r1_eval_with_gold.json` | Same + example gold subset (fixture-only; not MIDAS adjudication) |

**Caveat:** Heuristic Blue Agent mirrors the rule grader, so agreement/kappa on fixtures is inflated. Re-run with vLLM on MIDAS for real R1 numbers.
